text:
ana: Hey team — planning a 2-day hands-on workshop for cloud partners to onboard our ref-arch Terraform kit. Goal: hands-on labs, CI smoke tests, and a marketplace publish checklist. Who can help own curriculum + sample modules? :raised_hand:

mike: I can take curriculum + slides. Recommend split: day1 = quickstarts + lab walkthroughs, day2 = CI/ops + publishing. Timeline?

sophie: I'll own the labs repo and step-by-step labs. I'll create 3 labs: basic deploy, private VPC setup, and monitoring + tracing integration. Need module examples and test infra.

raj: I can prep the Terraform modules and a GitHub Actions pipeline example. Will add an example for GCP and AWS (Graviton/Arm note).

jess: Audience clarification — mostly cloud partner enablement engineers + one SI track for deeper workshops. Recommend separate breakout for SIs.

ana: Good call. Let's plan the SI breakout on afternoon of day2. Proposal: workshop week of May 6. Deliverables before May 1: slide deck draft, labs repo skeleton, sample modules, CI workflow, marketplace checklist.

mike: Timeline ack. I'll draft deck outline by Apr 18. Slide topics: goals, reference arch diagram, module patterns, ops playbook, publish steps.

sophie: Labs checklist (draft):
• repo with example modules
• README quickstart
• terraform.tfvars.sample
• automated smoke tests
• lab VM or infra creds doc
Will push skeleton by Apr 22.

raj: CI snippet for smoke test I'll include. Example GH Action command:
```yaml
- name: Run terraform init & plan
  run: |
    terraform init -input=false
    terraform plan -out=plan.tfplan
    terraform show -no-color plan.tfplan
```

cloud-partner-bot: calendar: Workshop - RefArch Terraform Enablement scheduled for 2024-05-07 09:00-17:00 (PT). Invite sent to @partners-eng, @solutions, @sdks. :calendar: 

ana: Assigning owners: mike (deck + facilitator), sophie (labs + lab instructions), raj (modules + CI), jess (SI breakout agenda). I'll coordinate partner invites and publicity.

mike: Also propose a short 'marketplace publish checklist' doc: package naming, entitlements, billing tags, binaries, test hooks. I'll create template in docs/marketplace-checklist.md

sophie: One more ask — can infra team provide a throwaway test account for partners? Need ephemeral creds for labs. @eng-infra any chance?

raj: I'll make module versions v0.1 with clear upgrade notes. Also add a sample of pinning model versions and quantization flags in module variables.

ana: Great. Next sync: Apr 25 10am PT. Please add any blockers to the thread. Thanks! :thumbsup:
